data.narrative:
Victus AI is a seed-stage defense and security company. The comparable universe consists of 10 private peers and 2 public companies (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) operating in the same sector. Analysis draws on three seed and Series A stage peers in defense AI: UFORCE ($1.0B), Singularity ($400M), and NODA AI ($125M).

The peer-median method is the applicable triangulation approach given available data. The median valuation across the three same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables is $400M, with a range of $125M to $1.0B. This method anchors to companies demonstrating comparable business model risk, market access, and stage dynamics. The dispersion across peers (8x spread from low to high) reflects heterogeneity in funding environment, technical differentiation, and customer validation within the defense AI subsector.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $340M to $460M, centered on $400M. This narrow band reflects reliance on a single triangulation method; broader confidence would require additional methods such as forward-revenue multiples or venture capital method calibration, neither of which are applicable without revenue or detailed financial projections. Key uncertainties include the target's differentiated defensibility relative to the peer set, customer acquisition trajectory in defense markets, and regulatory pathway clarity. The wide dispersion in comparable valuations ($125M–$1.0B) underscores substantial variance in how investors price seed-stage defense technology companies.
